description: Perform a steady-state BEM simulation to analyze spanwise aerodynamic loads. Open the 'Turbine Simulation' sample project from /home/ga/Documents/sample_projects/. In the HAWT BEM Simulation module, configure a 'Single Point' simulation with Wind Speed = 12 m/s and Tip Speed Ratio (TSR) = 7. Ensure Tip Loss and Hub Loss corrections are enabled. Run the simulation and visualize the local blade forces. Export the graph data (Position vs Normal Force and Tangential Force) to '/home/ga/Documents/spanwise_loads.txt'. Finally, identify the maximum Normal Force value from the results and write it to '/home/ga/Documents/max_load_report.txt' in the format 'Max_Fn = <value>'.
